# Independent ACIS SAT producers

Generated by `generate.py` using ezdxf 1.4.4, with its test metadata mode and a fixed ACIS creation date. The generator writes 24 deterministic files: BODY/REGION/3DSOLID × R2000/R2004/R2007/R2010 × ASCII/binary. The manifest pins their hashes and payload/geometry expectations.

BODY and 3DSOLID contain an ezdxf-generated cube. REGION contains an open planar rectangular body at z=2. The public modeler export API builds each SAT payload; the producer's own `AcisHeader` class supplies a long length-prefixed product identifier. Its encoded form contains a literal `\U+0041` and group 3 continuations. Each file also has legal-version common color/shadow metadata, following XData and a following LINE.

All producer files independently load through ezdxf's limited ACIS subset and extract their known mesh, with zero DXF audit errors or repairs. They qualify inert envelope fidelity and these known polyhedral payloads, not general ACIS/AutoCAD modeler behavior. See the focused [module documentation](../../../doc/dxf-conformance/acis-sat.md).
